papers.t: Enhanced denitrification performance of electrotrophic bio-cathode mediated by biochar and potential microbial mechanism
Enhanced effect and mechanism of biochar on the nitrogen removal of low C/N wastewater by cold-tolerant heterotrophic nitrifying–aerobic denitrifying bacterium

Biochar enhanced the nitrogen removal performance of heterotrophic nitrification-aerobic denitrification strain pseudomonas fluorescent sp. Z03 for insufficient carbon source wastewater under low temperature
